content:
Last month, after the TV tracking app TV Time shut down, one of its co-founders, Antonio Pinto, immediately announced the launch of a brand-new film and TV tracking app called Bingers, emphasising its social features. Here are the details.

Bingers is now available for download.

The TV tracking app TV Time was previously shut down by Whip Media. One of its co-founders immediately announced the launch of Bingers, positioning it as a "fast, beautiful and fun community-driven watchlist".

According to TechCrunch, Bingers is now available for download on iOS and Android, offering a "spiritual continuation" for users still searching for a TV Time replacement — TV Time once being one of the most popular TV tracking apps in the world.

Users who were formerly TV Time users and saved their data through the export tool provided before the platform shut down can import their archived data into Bingers and continue using the service seamlessly. As for users who did not export their data, or new users who have never used a TV tracking app, they can start from scratch and build their own viewing records.

Bingers strongly emphasises its community-driven features, such as user profiles, comments, episode ratings, GIFs, polls, and character popularity elections. Pinto told TechCrunch that these features are exactly why TV Time has remained popular for many years:

For users who simply want to keep track of the shows and movies they have watched, Bingers offers a dedicated watchlist and viewing history. Similar to TV Time, the app also displays an upcoming programme schedule with premiere dates, and counts down the days until broadcast.

Bingers is available for free download on the App Store and currently does not offer any in-app purchases.
